title: Varick Saffiano Leather Billfold Wallet With Passcase
description_html:
Varick Saffiano Leather Billfold Wallet With Passcase by Michael Kors. Designed with superior craftsmanship and luxury finishing.

Product Specifications

  • Dimensions: 4.3"W X 3.6"H X 0.5"D
  • Material: The leather in this product comes from tanneries receiving Leather Working Group Gold- or Silver-certification in recognition of their environmental performance., Saffiano leather
  • Hardware: Gunmetal hardware
  • Lining: 100% polyester
